lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.title: Butterfly from Big Shapes
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.summary: Build a friendly butterfly from one long body, four big wings and a pair of matching spots, then fill it with color.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.step.body_an: Start with a tall, soft oval for the body, then add two gentle antenna curves.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.help.body_an: Keep the body near the middle so both sides have lots of room for wings.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.complete.bod: Great center shape. Your butterfly has a body and antennae.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.step.big_win: Add two big upper wings and two smaller lower wings, matching left and right.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.help.big_win: Think of the wings like two pairs of soft leaves growing from the body.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.complete.big: Nice! Four big wings make the butterfly easy to see.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.step.friendl: Add one round spot on each side in nearly the same place.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.help.friendl: Look across the body and try to place the second spot like a mirror of the first.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.complete.fri: Your matching spots make the wings feel balanced.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.coloring.win: Choose colors for the two wings. They can match or be playful opposites.
lesson.butterfly_big_shapes.coloring.bod: Finish by coloring the butterfly body.
